aboutGame.title: What is Injustice 3?
paragraphs: Injustice 3 is the long-rumored next entry in NetherRealm Studios' DC fighting game series, following Injustice: Gods Among Us (2013) and Injustice 2 (2017). It continues the alternate-Earth saga where Batman and Superman clash over how heroes should rule, and it is expected to keep the cinematic story mode, meter-burn combat, and gear-driven customization that defined the first two games.

As of October 2026, Warner Bros. Games and NetherRealm have not officially announced Injustice 3, so there is no confirmed release date, roster, or trailer. This wiki tracks every announcement and community lead, from studio job listings to leaks, and keeps confirmed details, reported rumors, and fan wishlists clearly separated.

modules.description: Break down the combat systems the series is built on, including meter burn, clashes, gear, and the netcode the community wants Injustice 3 to ship with.

highlights.label: Light
highlights.detail: Fastest normal attack, used for pokes, hit-confirms, and combo starters.

highlights.label: Medium
highlights.detail: Mid-speed strike that links normals into special-move cancels.

highlights.label: Heavy
highlights.detail: Slow, high-damage attack best used as a punish or a combo ender.

highlights.label: Meter Burn
highlights.detail: Spend meter to extend combos, add armor, or change a special move's properties.

highlights.label: Clash
highlights.detail: A wager system that lets both fighters bet meter to steal damage or health back.

modules.name: Injustice 3 Beginner Guide
modules.description: A pre-launch training plan for players new to Injustice, covering the fundamentals, combos, and matchup habits that carry over from the first two games.

highlights.detail: Learn spacing and footsies first, because range control wins neutral in Injustice.
Practice one bread-and-butter combo per character before attempting long strings.
Manage meter carefully and spend it on damage only when it can close out a round.
Use clashes as a comeback tool by banking meter for the wager.
Study frame data so you know which moves are punishable on block.
Pick a main early and build matchup knowledge instead of spreading thin.

faq.title: Injustice 3 FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Injustice 3.

items.question: What is Injustice 3?
items.answer: Injustice 3 is the next entry in NetherRealm Studios' DC fighting game series, continuing the story of Injustice: Gods Among Us and Injustice 2 with a cinematic story mode, meter-burn combat, clashes, and gear-driven customization.

items.question: Has Injustice 3 been announced?
items.answer: No. As of October 2026, Warner Bros. Games and NetherRealm have not announced Injustice 3, and the game has no official release date, roster, or trailer.

items.question: When will Injustice 3 release?
items.answer: Injustice 3 has no confirmed release window. NetherRealm once alternated Mortal Kombat and Injustice releases every two years, but the gap widened after Mortal Kombat 11 and Mortal Kombat 1, so a launch is still years away.

items.question: Which characters will be in Injustice 3?
items.answer: Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, and the Joker are the safest bets to return in Injustice 3, while community wishlists push for newcomers like Constantine and Supergirl. No Injustice 3 roster has been confirmed.

items.question: What platforms will Injustice 3 be on?
items.answer: NetherRealm's recent fighters launched on PlayStation, Xbox, PC, and Nintendo Switch, so Injustice 3 would likely follow the same multi-platform pattern, though nothing has been confirmed.
